ac_results.evidence: tests 'corrupted store file is rejected with STORE_CORRUPTED, no stack trace leaked to stdout, exit code 1' and 'wrong-shape store file is rejected with STORE_CORRUPTED, exit code 1' → exit 1, stderr matches /store file is corrupted/, no stack-trace pattern (/at Object|\.js:\d+/) in stderr, stdout empty (does not fall through to the empty-list message)

assumptions: TASK-003's shared TodoStoreRepository (src/store.js) exists on disk but this scope's allowed_file_substrate is limited to src/commands/list.js and its test, with no shared store module in scope, so load() is implemented self-contained inside list.js (ENOENT->empty list, JSON.parse/shape failure->StoreCorruptedError) directly against contracts/todo-store.contract.md, matching the precedent already set in src/commands/done.js.

list.js exports an async run(args, {cwd, stdout, stderr}) function rather than reading process.argv directly — argv routing/dispatch is Non-Go for this task (TASK-008) — matching done.js's calling convention so bin/todo.js can dispatch to it uniformly.
Done marker is rendered as `[x]` for done and `[ ]` (single space) for not-done, per RULE-03's `[x|  ] <text>` pattern and UC-ListTodos Step 3's `[i] [x|  ] <text>` format.

The empty-list message text is exactly 'no todos yet' (lowercase, no trailing punctuation) — the spec only constrains it as a "no todos yet"-style, explicit, non-blank message; no exact string is pinned elsewhere.

Wrong-shape (parses as JSON but fails isValidShape) is treated identically to unparseable JSON as STORE_CORRUPTED, per UC-ListTodos Step 1 ('SyntaxError/shape → StoreCorruptedError') and covered by an added test even though only the unparseable case is itemized as a boundary case in TASK-005's checklist.
